arxiv-2104-06428.title: Simulating a ring-like Hubbard system with a quantum computer
arxiv-2104-06428.creator: Philippe Suchsland, Panagiotis Kl. Barkoutsos, Ivano Tavernelli, Mark H Fischer, Titus Neupert
arxiv-2104-06428.description: Abstract We develop a workflow to use current quantum computing hardware for solving quantum many-body problems, using the example of the fermionic Hubbard model. Concretely, we study a four-site Hubbard ring that exhibits a transition from a product state to an intrinsically interacting ground state as hopping amplitudes are changed.

arxiv-2109-00889.title: Dealing with Distribution Mismatch in Semi-supervised Deep Learning for Covid-19 Detection Using Chest X-ray Images: A Novel Approach Using Feature Densities
arxiv-2109-00889.creator: Saul Calderon-Ramirez 1 2 , Shengxiang Yang 1, David Elizondo 1 , Armaghan Moemeni 6
arxiv-2109-00889.description: Abstract In the context of the global coronavirus pandemic, different deep learning solutions for infected subject detection using chest X-ray images have been proposed. However, deep learning models usually need large labelled datasets to be effective. Semi-supervised deep learning is an attractive alternative, where unlabelled data is leveraged to improve the overall model’s accuracy.

arxiv-2302-06327.title: A damped elastodynamics system under the global injectivity condition: Local wellposedness in L p L^{p} -spaces
arxiv-2302-06327.creator: Sébastien Court
arxiv-2302-06327.description: Abstract The purpose of this paper is to model mathematically mechanical aspects of cardiac tissues. The latter constitute an elastic domain whose total volume remains constant. The time deformation of the heart tissue is modeled with the elastodynamics equations dealing with the displacement field as main unknown. These equations are coupled with a pressure whose variations characterize the heart beat.

arxiv-2306-03247.title: Construction d’un système de recommandation basé sur des contraintes via des graphes de connaissances
arxiv-2306-03247.creator: Ngoc Luyen Le \fup 1,2, Marie-Hélène Abel \fup 1, Philippe Gouspillou \fup 2 \fup 1 Université de technologie de Compiègne, CNRS, Heudiasyc (Heuristics and Diagnosis of Complex Systems), CS 60319 - 60203 Compiègne Cedex, France. \fup 2 Vivocaz, 8 B Rue de la Gare, 02200, Mercin-et-Vaux, France
arxiv-2306-03247.description: Abstract Knowledge graphs in RDF model entities and their relations using ontologies, and have gained popularity for information modeling. In recommender systems, knowledge graphs help represent more links and relationships between users and items. Constraint-based recommender systems leverage deep recommendation knowledge to identify relevant suggestions. When combined with knowledge graphs, they offer benefits in constraint sets.

arxiv-2310-02681.title: Stable accretion in young stars: The cases of EX Lupi and TW Hya 2023 Stable accretion in young stars: The cases of EX Lupi and TW Hya –
arxiv-2310-02681.creator: A. Sicilia-Aguilar, J. Campbell-White, V. Roccatagliata, J. Desira, S.G. Gregory, A. Scholz, M. Fang, F. Cruz-Saenz de Miera, Á. Kóspál, S. Matsumura, P. Ábrahám
arxiv-2310-02681.description: Abstract We examine the long-term spectroscopic and photometric variability of EX Lupi and TW Hya, studying the presence of stable accretion and the role it plays in the observed variability. Analysing the velocity modulations of the emission lines with STAR-MELT, we obtain information on the structure of the accretion columns and the disk-star connection.

arxiv-2404-14790.title: Pressure-dependent Electronic Superlattice in the Kagome-Superconductor CsV 3 Sb 5
arxiv-2404-14790.creator: F. Stier, A.-A. Haghighirad, G. Garbarino, S. Mishra, N. Stilkerich, D. Chen, C. Shekhar, T. Lacmann, C. Felser, T. Ritschel, J. Geck, M. Le Tacon
arxiv-2404-14790.description: Abstract We present a high-resolution single crystal x-ray diffraction study of kagome-superconductor CsV 3 Sb 5 , exploring its response to variations in pressure and temperature. We discover that at low temperatures, the structural modulations of the electronic superlattice, commonly associated with charge-density-wave order, undergo a transformation around p ∼ p\sim 0.

arxiv-2412-16339.title: Deliberative Alignment: Reasoning Enables Safer Language Models
arxiv-2412-16339.creator: Melody Y. Guan, Manas Joglekar, Eric Wallace, Saachi Jain, Boaz Barak, Alec Helyar, Rachel Dias, Andrea Vallone, Hongyu Ren, Jason Wei, Hyung Won Chung, Sam Toyer, Johannes Heidecke, Alex Beutel, Amelia Glaese
arxiv-2412-16339.description: Abstract As large-scale language models increasingly impact safety-critical domains, ensuring their reliable adherence to well-defined principles remains a fundamental challenge. We introduce Deliberative Alignment, a new paradigm that directly teaches the model safety specifications and trains it to explicitly recall and accurately reason over the specifications before answering.

arxiv-2506-01724.title: Active Learning via Vision-Language Model Adaptation with Open Data
arxiv-2506-01724.creator: Tong Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Shu Kong
arxiv-2506-01724.description: Abstract Pretrained on web-scale open data, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer powerful capabilities for solving downstream tasks, after being adapted to task-specific labeled data. However, data labeling can be expensive, especially when domain expertise is required. Active Learning (AL) aims to reduce this expense by strategically selecting the most informative data for labeling and model training.

arxiv-2509-09576.title: Build-up and survival of the disc: From numerical models of galaxy formation to the Milky Way 2025 Build-up and survival of the disc: From numerical models of galaxy formation to the Milky Way – D
arxiv-2509-09576.creator: Matthew D. A. Orkney, Chervin F. P. Laporte
arxiv-2509-09576.description: Abstract We study the build-up and survival of angular momentum in the stellar disc using a statistical suite of cosmological simulations of Milky Way-mass galaxies. arxiv-2511-07551.title: The impact of precession and higher-order multipoles on cosmological inference
arxiv-2511-07551.creator: Charlie Hoy, Konstantin Leyde
arxiv-2511-07551.description: Abstract Gravitational-wave astronomy presents an exciting opportunity to provide an independent measurement of the expansion rate of the Universe. By combining inferences for the binary component masses and luminosity distances from individual observations, it is possible to infer H 0 H_{0} without direct electromagnetic counterparts or galaxy catalogs.

arxiv-2511-13491.title: On moduli of foliated surfaces
arxiv-2511-13491.creator: Calum Spicer, Roberto Svaldi and Sebastián Velazquez
arxiv-2511-13491.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Calum Spicer, Roberto Svaldi and Sebastián Velazquez. We present a definition of stable family of foliations and show that the corresponding moduli functor for foliated surfaces is representable by a Deligne-Mumford stack. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification
37F75, 14J10, 14E30

1. Introduction

Recently, there has been considerable progress in the study of the birational geometry of foliations coming from the development of the Minimal Model Program (MMP) for foliations.

It traverses the Tuscan Apennines—in which it rises at a point some 12 m. of Pieve San Stefano, 4160 ft. above sea-level —in a series of picturesque ravines, skirts the west foot of the Sabine Mountains in a broad shallow valley, then crosses the Roman Campagna, cutting its way through Rome, and finally enters the Tyrrhenian (Mediterranean) Sea by two arms at Ostia and Fiumicino, the latter artificial.

pmc-11295431.title: Implementation of a soft grading system for chemistry in a Moodle plugin: reaction handling
pmc-11295431.creator: Louis Plyer, Gilles Marcou, Céline Perves, Fanny Bonachera, Alexander Varnek
pmc-11295431.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Here, we present a new method for evaluating questions on chemical reactions in the context of remote education. This method can be used when binary grading is not sufficient as some tolerance may be acceptable. In order to determine a grade, the developed workflow uses the pairwise similarity assessment of two considered reactions, each encoded by a single molecular graph with the help of the Condensed Graph of Reaction (CGR) approach.

pmc-11303426.title: Outcomes of patients admitted with malignant small bowel obstruction: a subgroup multicentre observational cohort analysis
pmc-11303426.creator: N B Hupfeld, J Burcharth, T K Jensen, I Lolle, L B J Nielsen, M A Tolver, A P Skovsen, H G Smith
pmc-11303426.description: Introduction and purpose of the studySmall bowel obstruction (SBO) accounts for a substantial proportion of emergency surgical admissions. Malignancy is a common cause of obstruction, either due to a primary tumour or intra-abdominal metastases. However, little is known regarding the current treatment or outcomes of patients with malignant SBO.

pmc-13054674.title: Isolated Esophageal Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis in an Adult: A Case Report
pmc-13054674.creator: Jingxin Ye, Jing Hou, Zilong Ni, Mengmeng Ye, Feng Su
pmc-13054674.description: Langerhans cell histiocytosis (LCH) is an inflammatory neoplastic disease characterized by the clonal proliferation of Langerhans cells, with a very low incidence, mostly in children. LCH in adults is extremely rare, with esophageal involvement being particularly uncommon. Its insidious onset and nonspecific manifestations often lead to diagnostic challenges and delayed diagnosis.
